description: Third-party and fork sources fetched on demand by `bun scripts/tools/vendor/fetch.ts`: pinned, shallow and blobless. Fetched trees are git-ignored; nothing here is vendored into the repository. Bun (aphrody-labs/bun, branch main) is the only vendored source. Deno (aphrody-labs/deno) is pinned to v2.9.7, the release built on deno_core 0.412.0 that Obscura embeds (crates/web/obscura-js), as a source reference without tests/.
